name: Gacha Banner
description: A pool, a window, and a counter the player can see. A banner is a time-boxed pool with rate-ups on featured outcomes, and its counter is the thing that makes it fair to run at all: pulls-since-featured is an output, not an internal, so a player always knows where they stand. Spark — a guaranteed exchange after a declared number of pulls — is supported as a first-class input because a pool with no ceiling is a pool that can take an unbounded amount for nothing. Rotation is announced ahead of expiry rather than at it, and counters carry across a rotation or reset according to a declared rule rather than by accident. VIRTUAL CURRENCY ONLY: this component has no concept of a payment method, and adding one would be a different contract with a different name.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: banners
inputs.description: Banner definitions: id, pool table, featured outcomes, rate-up multiplier and window. Required.

inputs.name: sparkAtPulls
inputs.description: Pulls after which the featured outcome may be exchanged outright. 0 disables the ceiling, which should be a deliberate decision.

inputs.name: counterCarriesOnRotation
inputs.description: Whether pity and spark counters survive a banner rotation.

inputs.name: announceRotationHours
inputs.description: Notice given before a banner closes.

outputs.name: activeBanner
outputs.description: The banner currently open, or null.

outputs.name: sparkProgress
outputs.description: Fraction of the way to a guaranteed exchange.
